setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays one trig on step 1: root C (MIDI 60, C3) at velocity 50, held for 4 steps. Chd1 to Chd4 on the Masks page are E, G, A and C (MIDI 64, 67, 69, 72) and the output is polyphonic. Trig params is open on its parameter list, showing Chord Pattern. Chord Note Strum is already assigned and set to 1/2, half a step.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Press K3 to assign Chord Pattern and K2 to return, then turn E3 one detent to -> (forward). Turn E2 to the next slot, press K2 and turn E3 to Mute Chord Root.
steps.title: Choose forward order

steps.caption: Assign Mute Chord Root and leave it at X so the root still sounds; then assign Chord Velocity Mod and turn E3 to +10 (E2 moves to the next slot, K2 opens the list, E3 browses, K3 assigns, K2 returns). Tap Play (1,8), then tap it again to stop. The five slots are the root and Chd1 to Chd4. The MIDI strip lists them in that order, half a step apart, root first: C3 (60), E3 (64), G3 (67), A3 (69) and C4 (72).
steps.title: Hear the root first
